notes: *One* and *another* are supplied contrastive determiners on the two דּוֹר tokens under rule 15's correlative sentence, not added words; no numeral stands in either phrase.
לְעוֹלָם is split, each morpheme holding a word of its own (*for* / *ever*), so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet; the participle עֹמָדֶת is discontinuous from it under rule 25.
